content_of_post_to_comment: I just learned that there’s this thing called fast-drafting in which authors finish draft zero in two weeks, maybe a little more. It comes from the premise that you can’t edit a blank page, so you have to get something down first (and fast). I have so many questions. Like… are you okay? Leaving jokes aside. Has anyone tried this? Is it pure genius or just unhinged?
comment: The interesting tension is that fast-drafting treats writing as discovery rather than execution. I wonder if the real skill is not speed, but learning when to switch from exploring to judging.
